spanish: Y a puerta del atrio masaj de veinte codo, azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino torcido, obra de bordador; sus columnas cuatro, y sus basas cuatro.

findings.issue: Common noun (masculine singular absolute) is dumped untranslated as masaj; it is not a proper name.
Strong's H8336 / lemma 8336 b and the morph (cardinal feminine singular) conflict; lino fino resolves that open conflict as fine linen and adds a textile plus fineness.
Unmarked de links an absolute noun to the following cardinal; Hebrew has juxtaposition only. Smoothing, no new referent.
The construct gate is definite via the article on the court; puerta is indefinite.

notes: Conjunctions, twenty, singular cubit, the dye nouns, the passive twisted participle, work of the embroiderer, and both fours with 3mp suffixes match the tokens.
